note: Tests that write under the repo's runtime/, src/, fixtures/, config/, scripts/ or recipes/ in place, as found by scripts/test_tests_write_no_tracked_file.mjs. Pinned per file: a file's count must equal its pin, and the pins may only go down (PIN_TOTAL_CEILING in that test). One reason per write in sites. Every write here is a hand-run golden refresh behind a flag; none runs in a normal or parallel test run.
